args.intent: Which table in the bench warehouse would you use to look up when a customer's account was created?
The bench warehouse contains more than one table of order data. Which one is the current, supported table for order analysis?
Which table in the bench warehouse holds customer profile attributes such as tier and region?
Which table in the bench warehouse provides pre-aggregated daily revenue by region, so you do not have to aggregate raw orders yourself?
Which table in the bench warehouse would you query for individual customer order transactions (one row per order)?
Per the company revenue reporting policy, what was the revenue in USD for the East region in March 2025? Round to the nearest cent.

args.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.amount - o.discount) / 100e0, 2) AS revenue_usd FROM memory.bench.orders o JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.region = 'East' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'

args.intent: Per the company revenue reporting policy, which region had the highest revenue in calendar year 2025? Answer with the region name.

args.sql: SELECT c.region FROM memory.bench.orders o JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY SUM(o.amount - o.discount) DESC LIMIT 1

args.intent: Per the company revenue reporting policy, what was the company's total revenue in USD for calendar year 2025? Round to the nearest cent.

args.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount - discount) / 100e0, 2) AS revenue_usd FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

args.intent: What is the average order amount in USD across all orders placed by enterprise-tier customers in the bench warehouse? Round to the nearest cent.

args.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.amount) / 100e0, 2) AS avg_usd FROM memory.bench.orders o JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'enterprise'

args.intent: Using the bench warehouse, what was the total order amount in USD across ALL orders (any status) placed in Q1 2025 (2025-01-01 through 2025-03-31)? Round to the nearest cent.

args.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount) / 100e0, 2) AS total_usd FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
